counts.what: k(n) of N against the model's P(n) at the measured f; chi2 with the chip's and the simulator's binomial variance at the model's P plus sigma_f^2 g g^T, g = P(f = 1) - P(f = 0); 'none' leaves out the f term. Groups: sums over the five days, one job each

equivalence.what: Lambda_X, O - M. Equivalent within a margin when the 90% t interval lies inside it (two one-sided tests at 5%); certified margin: the larger end of that interval. Power: the chance of certifying the margin if the model were exactly right, five units, at the observed sd between them and at the stated errors alone

prespecified pool (WL, inverse variance.note: the ten repetitions as independent; the prediction's own error left out, as in the rule
